## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as the new teacher for [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Upon starting the term, she took over [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's class and guided her as she thrived in her studies. Miss Stacy encouraged student activities, including organizing a Christmas concert and assigning compositions. At the end of the school term, she announced to her students that she would return the following year to help prepare them for their [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a helpful, inspiring school teacher to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who thrives under her guidance after returning to school in October. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly anticipates attending her classes, writes compositions for her, and receives reassurance from Miss Stacy regarding her future preparation for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. With Miss Stacy's instruction, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ultimately achieves a tie for first place on the Island in the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) results.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
